title: Decision
description: A governance decision record emitted by phase14 for each candidate patch.

candidate_id.description: The candidate patch or skill that was evaluated.

reason_code.description: Machine-readable outcome code. Use F-XXX for failures, OK for promotion.

invariants_checked.description: List of invariant IDs checked during evaluation (e.g. INV-001).

invariants_violated.description: Subset of invariants_checked that were violated.

timestamp_iso8601.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the decision was made.

phase.description: Phase14 pipeline phase where this decision was made.

operator_override.description: True if a human operator overrode the automated decision.

operator_id.description: GitHub username of operator who made the override (if applicable).
